subject.title: Surface internal system messages in a distinct UI block instead of normal chat bubbles

question: Should visible internal/runtime transcript entries become a first-class system/diagnostic audience, or should remaining internal entries be hidden from chat instead?
rationale: Current code has several source-specific filters and projections, but the requested generic presentation requires a product/API decision about transparency, transcript semantics, and cross-client parity before a narrow implementation is safe.

options.title: Add system audience and block rendering
options.body: Introduce explicit runtime/system audience metadata in the gateway display projection and render it as a labeled diagnostic block in Control UI/TUI.

options.title: Hide remaining internals
options.body: Treat continuation and runtime rows as agent-only by default and omit them from visible chat unless a later diagnostics surface is designed.

options.title: Keep source-specific filters
options.body: Continue fixing each leak path separately, accepting that there is no generic system-message presentation contract yet.

recommendation.title: Add system audience and block rendering
recommendation.body: Introduce explicit runtime/system audience metadata in the gateway display projection and render it as a labeled diagnostic block in Control UI/TUI.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Control UI product behavior and gateway display projection, both areas with recent steipete ownership signals.
